name: codegraph
description: Deterministic multi-root code knowledge graph over MCP, with hooks that inject structural context on every prompt and keep the graph current on every edit.

backend_python.title: Backend interpreter
backend_python.description: Python that has graphify or code-review-graph installed. Leave empty to use the venv created by `make install`.

context_budget.title: Prompt context budget (tokens)
context_budget.description: Cap on graph context injected before each prompt.
